subject: Problem with Axis control in ggplot2 and Shiny

messages.author: 6a2a3360bdab94f4
messages.subject: Problem with Axis control in ggplot2 and Shiny
parts:
I am generating an error that I cannot resolve and am wondering if anyone else has an answer.
 
I am trying to build adaptive plot scaling that has a set minimum and maximum scale values but adjusts the scale (and location of an annotation). In the process I generate the following error:
 
Error: 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0
 
The code chunk is found here:
 
# Create dataframe used for creating risk plots and deriving risk numbers
y <- reactive(
as.data.frame(AOQ_fun(input$meas_var^2,input$meas_bias,input$proc_var^2,input$proc_bias,input$tol_U,input$tol_L))
)
#Create Plot Scaling factors
plotYLimit <- reactive(ifelse(max(y()$AOQ) < 0.25 & max(y()$JCR) < 0.25 & max(y()$JPR) < 0.25,
0.25,
ifelse(max(y()$AOQ) >= 0.95 | max(y()$JCR) >= 0.95 | max(y()$JPR) >= 0.95,
1.00,
max(c(max(y()$AOQ),max(y()$JCR),max(y()$JPR)))+0.05)))
textLoc <- reactive(ifelse(max(y()$AOQ) < 0.25 & max(y()$JCR) < 0.25 & max(y()$JPR) < 0.25,
0.23,
ifelse(max(y()$AOQ) >= 0.95 | max(y()$JCR) >= 0.95 | max(y()$JPR) >= 0.95,
0.98,
plotYLimit()+0.03)))
initLimit <- reactive(0.0)
initLoc <- reactive(0.00)
It appears that the offending issue has to do with max(c(max(y()$AOQ),max(y()$JCR),max(y()$JPR)))+0.05
 
  • If I execute this at the command lin with y loaded, I get : max(c(max(y$AOQ),max(y$JCR),max(y$JPR)))+0.05      [1] 0.5603253
  • If I substitue this value into plotYLimit <- reactive(0.5603253) the plots work
  • But when I use the ifelse statement, however this is changing the evaluation of the max() function. it delivers and error.
